eu5ab_rebuild_candidate_priority = {
	cmm_build_list_ordered_values = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_priority list_name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
	# Saved games without an initialized CMM list retain deterministic defaults.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_new value = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_country
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter value = 0 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
			scope:eu5ab_priority_country = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter add = 1 }
				switch = {
					trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
					flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_new value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter
	}
}

eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_global_budget_mode = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_global_budget_mode = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 4
		} }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_global_budget_mode = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 6
		} }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_global_budget_mode = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 8
		} }
	}
	else = {
		# Defensive fallback for settings saved by an incompatible CMM version.
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 6
		} }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining value = var:eu5ab_global_budget_limit }
}

# Persistent twenty-bucket location registry. Policy application and owner
# changes maintain it incrementally; monthly scans never rebuild all locations.
eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket } }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_registry_location
		owner = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment value = 0 } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment > 20 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version value = 1 }
			scope:eu5ab_registry_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment } }
			switch = {
				trigger = var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment
				1 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				2 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				3 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				4 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				5 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_5_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				6 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_6_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				7 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_7_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				8 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_8_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				9 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_9_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				10 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_10_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }

				18 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				19 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }

eu5ab_unregister_location_from_scan = {

		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket }

		owner = {
			switch = {
				trigger = scope:eu5ab_registry_location.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket
				1 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				2 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				3 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }

# wrote policy bindings without registering their locations in the buckets.

	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment
	every_owned_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket
			eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version value = 1 }
}

eu5ab_reset_policy_budgets_if_needed = {
	eu5ab_template_ensure_defaults = yes
	# Initialize once and refresh the shared CMM budget each January.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_budget_initialized }
				current_month = 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = eu5ab_budget_initialized
		eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap value = 0 }
	}
	# Snapshot performance settings once. Mid-run changes apply next month.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_parallel value = var:eu5ab_global_parallel_location_scan }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit value = var:eu5ab_global_daily_location_task_limit }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_max_additions value = var:eu5ab_global_max_additions_per_run }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_early_stop value = var:eu5ab_global_early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient }
	clamp_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit min = 1 max = 30 }
	clamp_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_max_additions min = 0 max = 600 }
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
	if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 2 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 3 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 4 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 5 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 6 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 7 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 8 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 9 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 10 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 11 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 11 } }
	if = { limit = { current_month = 12 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_month value = 12 } }
	# Count only locations indexed after this Mod confirmed a project.
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_country
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_active_project_locations
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_location
		if = {
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_active_building_types
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_building_type
				if = {
					limit = { scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_active_building_baselines is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } } }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { "location_building_level(scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type)" > { value = "variable_map(eu5ab_active_building_baselines|scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type)" } } }
						scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
						scope:eu5ab_active_project_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } }
					}
					else = { scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } } }
				}
				else = { scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_building_type } } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_baseline_workers max_rgo_workers <= { value = var:eu5ab_active_rgo_baseline_workers } eu5ab_rgos_under_construction > 0 }
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } }
			}
			else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction remove_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_baseline_workers }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country
				OR = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_active_project_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_location } }
		}
	}
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_location
		scope:eu5ab_active_project_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_location } }
	}
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
	# Persistent scan buckets are maintained when a policy is applied or a
	# location changes owner. No all-owned-location rebuild occurs here.
	# The slider is extra concurrent capacity: 0 means one total slot, 599 means 600.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > 600 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = 600 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_base_quota value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_hard_cap value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_hard_cap_result value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions > 0 var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects >= { value = var:eu5ab_diag_base_quota } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_concurrent_limit_state value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_concurrent_limit_state = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_final_quota value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_target value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_target multiply = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget multiply = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget > 600 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = 600 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_task_capacity value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_task_capacity multiply = 20 }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_task_capacity } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_scan_task_capacity } }
	# One candidate per daily bucket keeps small quotas representative without
	# recreating the former all-locations day-22 sort.
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget < 20 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = 20 } }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
	eu5ab_prepare_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day value = 1 }
		set_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 }
		# Queue preparation also performs stale-state cleanup, but an empty
		# check must not be displayed as a prepared construction queue.
		remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_queue_state
	}
}

	# Each deeply-scored location enters exactly one RGO gate result.
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_checked add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_capacity_available = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_capacity add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_location_available = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_location add = 1 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_enabled = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_disabled add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_finance_available = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_finance add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_utilization_allowed = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_utilization add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_workforce_allowed = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_workforce add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_market_need_present = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_market_need add = 1 }
	}

		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_eligible add = 1 }
		# RGO participates in the same per-location diagnostic choice as buildings.
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority add = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
					var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
			remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = eu5ab_rgo_queue_order_score }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion multiply = 1000 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority
		eu5ab_stage_rgo_candidate = yes
	}
}

		limit = { var:eu5ab_active_template_slot = 19 }
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_19 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_active_template_slot = 20 }
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_20 = yes
	}
}

# Build one transient view for the template currently opened in the scope window.
# The previous implementation recalculated 20 slots and every preset on each click.
eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_province_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_area_count value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		remove_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_selected
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_template_slot = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_view_selected value = 1 }
					root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count add = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
					if = {
						limit = { var:eu5ab_policy_id = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_view_selected value = 1 }
						root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count add = 1 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_selected }
			province = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces } }
					add_to_temporary_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces
				}
			}
			area = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas } }
					add_to_temporary_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Count only the deduplicated parents reached from selected owned locations.
	# This replaces the former every_province/every_area world scans.
	every_in_list = {
		list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces
		root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_province_count add = 1 } }
	}
	every_in_list = {
		list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas
		root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_area_count add = 1 } }
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = {
	scope:actor ?= {
		eu5ab_template_slot_1_ensure_defaults = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_saved } }
			eu5ab_template_slot_1_save = yes
		}
	}
	scope:target_location ?= {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 1 }
		remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
		eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_province = {
	scope:target_province ?= {
		every_location_in_province = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			save_scope_as = target_location
			scope:actor ?= { eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = yes }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_area = {
	scope:target_area ?= {
		every_location_in_area = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			save_scope_as = target_location
			scope:actor ?= { eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = yes }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_scan_regional_development_bucket = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_scan_country
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget divide = 20 ceiling = yes } }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit } }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day = 1 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_build_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_failure_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_recent_build_penalty <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					num_civil_constructions < 1
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				}
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_wait_months } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months value = 0 } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				num_civil_constructions < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
			}
			order_by = eu5ab_location_need_score
			max = 30

					trigger_event_silently = { on_action = eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action }
				}
				else = { eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day = 19 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_build_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_failure_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_recent_build_penalty <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } }
			if = {

					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }

		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				num_civil_constructions < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
			}
			order_by = eu5ab_location_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } var:eu5ab_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { var:eu5ab_scan_early_stop <= 0 var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				if = {
					limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_scan_parallel > 0 }
					trigger_event_silently = { on_action = eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action }
				}
				else = { eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes }
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				num_civil_constructions < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				NOT = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			}
			order_by = eu5ab_location_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } var:eu5ab_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { var:eu5ab_scan_early_stop <= 0 var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				if = {
					limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_scan_parallel > 0 }
					trigger_event_silently = { on_action = eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action }
				}
				else = { eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day = 20 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_build_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_failure_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_recent_build_penalty <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					num_civil_constructions < 1
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				}
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_wait_months } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months value = 0 } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				num_civil_constructions < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
			}
			order_by = eu5ab_location_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } var:eu5ab_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { var:eu5ab_scan_early_stop <= 0 var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				if = {
					limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_scan_parallel > 0 }
					trigger_event_silently = { on_action = eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action }
				}
				else = { eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes }
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				num_civil_constructions < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				NOT = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			}
			order_by = eu5ab_location_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } var:eu5ab_deep_score_attempts < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { var:eu5ab_scan_early_stop <= 0 var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				if = {
					limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_scan_parallel > 0 }
					trigger_event_silently = { on_action = eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action }
				}
				else = { eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_parallel <= 0 } eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget
	remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts
}

eu5ab_finish_regional_development_scan = {
	# EU5 drops variables set to zero; persist non-zero snapshot states for GUI reads.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_run_day value = 22 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_run_state } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 } }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_covered_locations <= 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed <= 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 4 } }
	eu5ab_start_engine_candidate_queue = yes
}

eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_stage_engine_candidate = yes }
	}
}

eu5ab_try_construct_current_policy = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_rank
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_country
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					switch = {
						trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
						flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_new_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_expansion_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_expansion_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_new_candidates = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_location_candidate_staged }
			eu5ab_current_policy_auto_builds_input_sources = yes
		}
		eu5ab_try_construct_current_input_source = yes
	}
	# Strict mode performs one bounded structural look-back only when no
	# workforce-feasible candidate survived the pre-filter.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate }
			owner.var:eu5ab_global_pause_low_workforce > 0
		}
		owner = {
			ordered_buildable_building_type = {
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				limit = {
					eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
					eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
					eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
					NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes }
					eu5ab_inputs_available = yes
					OR = {
						AND = { eu5ab_current_building_allowed = yes eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes }
						AND = { eu5ab_current_input_source_building_allowed = yes eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = yes }
					}
				}
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_workforce add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_no_legal add = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
	remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_rank
}

eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 }
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_actual_profit_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
				eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
		}
		}
		else = {
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
				eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason

eu5ab_stage_current_expansion_candidates = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 }
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_actual_profit_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes

			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate

			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand }

			if = {
				limit = {

							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }

				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }

			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
		}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_try_construct_current_input_source = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_rank
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					switch = {
						trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
						flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_upgrade_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_new_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_expansion_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_upgrade_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_expansion_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_new_candidates = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_stage_current_input_upgrade_candidates = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 }
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_actual_profit_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_input_source_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
				eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
				eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
		}
		}
		else = {
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_input_source_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
				eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
				eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }

		}

		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_new }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
		}
		}
		else = {
		ordered_buildable_building_type = {
			max = { value = var:eu5ab_global_candidates_per_location }
			check_range_bounds = no
			order_by = eu5ab_current_candidate_score
			limit = {
				eu5ab_current_input_source_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_current_special_building_allowed = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_location_can_build = yes
				eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
				eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = yes
				eu5ab_candidate_is_new_build = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority value = owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_new }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
						AND = {
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							NOT = { var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority } }
							var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_score < { value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score value = var:eu5ab_candidate_diag_score }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_priority
			remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_diag_score
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_reason value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_updates_worker_top }
		}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_deduct_current_candidate_budget = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_cost }
		owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_candidate_cost } }
		remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_cost
	}
}

eu5ab_try_construct_rgo_need = {
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_rgo_expansion_allowed = yes }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_queue_before_attempt value = num_civil_constructions }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_rgo_baseline_workers value = max_rgo_workers }
		construct_rgo_upgrade = { }
		if = {
			# The native effect can reject hidden vanilla constraints; charge only on success.
			limit = { num_civil_constructions > var:eu5ab_queue_before_attempt }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty value = 12 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions add = 1 }
			set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
			set_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick value = 0 }
				}
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick add = 1 }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = 1 }
			}
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining subtract = 100 } }
		}
		else = {
			remove_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_baseline_workers
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_queue_before_attempt
	}
}

# Reserve a candidate's material demand immediately after approval so
# later candidates in the same GUI drain see the already-planned load.
eu5ab_commit_candidate_construction_demand = {
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_books value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
			}
			change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_books add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_books|scope:eu5ab_material_market)" }
			remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books key = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books key = scope:eu5ab_material_market value = local_var:eu5ab_new_committed_books }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_clay > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_clay value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_clay }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_clay
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_clay target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
			}
			change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_clay add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_clay|scope:eu5ab_material_market)" }

		}

		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_cloth key = scope:eu5ab_material_market value = local_var:eu5ab_new_committed_cloth }

# Snapshot only meaningful queue progress. GUI callbacks may still fire while
# processing is stuck, so animation activity alone is not a liveness signal.
eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase value = var:eu5ab_q_phase }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_processed value = var:eu5ab_q_processed }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_seen value = var:eu5ab_q_seen }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_confirmed value = var:eu5ab_q_confirmed }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country-only reducer. It runs on the following day in parallel mode and
# immediately after dispatch in serial mode, preserving insertion order.
eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_worker_merge_country
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
		limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_types
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve add = 1 } } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_rgo } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve add = 1 } } } }

					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = eu5ab_location_candidate_staged
			}
		}
		if = {

				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				scope:eu5ab_q_stage_country = {
					if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_staged add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_staged add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 }
				}

					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_staged add = 1 }

					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 }

		if = {

# RGO actions are staged too, so the hidden bridge can execute them at their
# exact user-selected position between ordinary candidate classes.
eu5ab_stage_rgo_candidate = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_stage_location }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_rgo_queue_score value = eu5ab_rgo_queue_order_score }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_active }
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_2_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_3_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_4_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_5_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_6_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_7_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_8_rgo value = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }

			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}

			owner = {

eu5ab_start_engine_candidate_queue = {
	eu5ab_sort_candidate_queue = yes
	eu5ab_sort_rgo_candidate_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { var:eu5ab_q_staged > 0 var:eu5ab_q_rgo_staged > 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_active value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 }
		eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
		trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_queue_watchdog.1 days = 2 }
		eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
	}
	else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
}

eu5ab_reset_engine_priority_phase_progress = {
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 } every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_done_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_approved_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_seen_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_best_actual remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_done remove_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved remove_variable = eu5ab_q_queue_before remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_cost remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_income remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_profit remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override } }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 } every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_locations remove_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }

	eu5ab_reset_engine_priority_phase_progress = yes
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 } every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_failed_types } }

	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 } every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_locations clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_failed_types } }
