# Predicted-profit selection first records the strongest engine-valued candidate
# in each location. One priority point adds a 1% soft bonus based on the
# absolute profit magnitude (floored at 1), so priorities can decide close
# comparisons without defeating a materially larger predicted monthly profit.
eu5ab_record_actual_profit_candidate = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_configured_priority }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = { value = var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude multiply = -1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude < 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = 1 } }
	set_variable = {
		name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
		value = {
			value = var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
			multiply = var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
			multiply = 0.01
			add = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank }
				var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank < { value = var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_actual value = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank value = var:eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank }
		clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
}

eu5ab_prepare_actual_profit_selection = {
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_locations
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = 0 }
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_country
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank
			max = 600
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_location
			scope:eu5ab_q_profit_country = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_profit_location }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_2_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank
			max = 600
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_location
			scope:eu5ab_q_profit_country = {

		}
	}

			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_locations

			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank
			max = 600
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_location
			scope:eu5ab_q_profit_country = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_profit_location }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_4_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }

			max = 600

			save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_location

				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_profit_location }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_5_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_5_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank
			max = 600
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_profit_location
			scope:eu5ab_q_profit_country = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_profit_location }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_6_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_6_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank

	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_7_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_7_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
			order_by = var:eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank
			max = 600

	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_8_locations }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_locations
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }

				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_q_expected > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_last value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds value = 0 }
		set_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 6 }
		eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
	}
	else = { eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes }
}

eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = {
	eu5ab_reset_engine_priority_phase_progress = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase
	eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
}

eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = {
	eu5ab_clear_engine_priority_phase = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:eu5ab_q_phase < 8
			var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
		}
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase add = 1 }
		eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
	}
	else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
}

# Root is an approved location. Reserve actual engine cost without
# charging the annual pool until queue growth confirms success.
eu5ab_reserve_engine_candidate = {
	owner = {
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_cost }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_cost }
	}
}

eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = {
	owner = {
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_cost }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_cost }
	}
}

eu5ab_commit_engine_candidate_budget = {
	owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_cost } }
	eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = yes
}

# Called by the validation GUI after all actual-value gates pass.
eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_queue_before value = num_civil_constructions }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_cost value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_income value = scope:eu5ab_engine_income }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_profit value = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit }
	set_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved
	add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_approved_location
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_approved_location } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_approved_location }
		}
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_cost value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_income value = scope:eu5ab_engine_income }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_profit value = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit }
	}
	eu5ab_reserve_engine_candidate = yes
	eu5ab_commit_candidate_construction_demand = yes
}

# Queue confirmation is the only place that settles annual budget and cooldown.
eu5ab_confirm_engine_candidate = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	if = {
		limit = { num_civil_constructions > var:eu5ab_q_queue_before }
		eu5ab_commit_engine_candidate_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
		remove_variable = eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions
		set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = "location_building_level(scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty value = 12 }
		owner = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used add = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = 3 }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes } } owner = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = 2 } } }
	}
	else = {
		eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = yes
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
		owner = { set_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase }
		owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
	}
	owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed add = 1 } }
	add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
}

# Script-event watchdog for the hidden GUI bridge. It ignores callback activity
# and requires phase, processed, seen, or confirmed to make real progress.
eu5ab_check_engine_candidate_queue_watchdog = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_processed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_seen
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_confirmed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:eu5ab_q_phase > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase }
					var:eu5ab_q_processed > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_processed }
					var:eu5ab_q_seen > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_seen }
					var:eu5ab_q_confirmed > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_confirmed }
				}
			}
			eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
		}
		else = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks add = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks >= 2 }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
			eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_quota_used value = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_rgo_quota_used value = var:eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:eu5ab_diag_built_this_run = 1 } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:eu5ab_diag_queue_state = 5 } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 4 } }
	eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
	# Keep phase/expected/tick counters as harmless sentinels until the next
	# prepare call; an already-scheduled GUI animation may finish one frame late.
}

# Internal save migration. Persistent templates, settings, budgets, and
# already-confirmed construction markers are deliberately preserved.
eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = {
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_migration_country
	every_owned_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction } }
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_migration_active_location
			scope:eu5ab_migration_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_migration_active_location } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_runtime_schema_version value = 2 }
}

eu5ab_recover_runtime_after_load = {
	# A saved mid-scan or mid-GUI queue is transient and cannot be resumed safely.
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day
	# Persistent scan buckets and their round-robin cursor survive loads.
	every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations eu5ab_clear_location_worker_state = yes remove_variable = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score }
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
	every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_unsorted_locations clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_building_types remove_variable = eu5ab_location_candidate_staged remove_variable = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score }
	every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_locations clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_building_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_done_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_approved_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_seen_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_failed_types remove_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved remove_variable = eu5ab_q_queue_before remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_cost remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_income remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_profit remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override remove_variable = eu5ab_location_candidate_staged remove_variable = eu5ab_action_taken remove_variable = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score }
	every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_rgo_locations remove_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo remove_variable = eu5ab_action_taken remove_variable = eu5ab_cached_rgo_queue_score remove_variable = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score }
	eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_expected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
	remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_5_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_6_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_7_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_staged
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version } } eu5ab_rebuild_scan_registry_v1 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version < 1 } eu5ab_rebuild_scan_registry_v1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_runtime_schema_version } } eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_runtime_schema_version < 2 } eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = yes }
}
